use_matrix.viewing: ORT_recent iteminfo calls it the public electronic viewing service; public viewing/access is evidenced. This is not an offline reuse grant.
use_matrix.offline_research: No product-specific permission or prohibition for offline research appears in the reviewed terms/metadata; unresolved.
use_matrix.retaining_vector_metadata: No explicit license clause covers copying or retaining the date-footprint polygon geometries. For ORT_recent, the service says to contact Geoportal for use in other information systems; this does not itself set a retention/reuse license. For ORT10LT_2024_2026 the records remain generic and inconclusive.
use_matrix.publishing_derived_observations: No reviewed clause grants derivative publication or states attribution, modification, redistribution, or commercial-use conditions for derived observations; unresolved.

other_official_sources.geoportal_copyright: https://www.geoportal.lt/geoportal/web/en/copyright lists ORT10LT and names National Land Service under the Ministry of Environment as copyright holder. It is a holder/attribution notice, not a license grant.

data_gov_lt.result: All returned HTTP 500 with an upstream block page (“The URL you requested has been blocked”). No authoritative data.gov.lt dataset record or license could be retrieved; this is an access limitation, not evidence that no record exists.

other_official_sources.geoportal_service_registry: NŽT Download/View services pages are public HTML shells embedding the official Metadata Discovery app. The app JS inspected does not itself supply license text. No separate license URL was located in those records.

rights_conclusion: Based only on retrieved official primary terms, it is possible to affirm public viewing and a generic License classification, but not offline reuse, retaining vector metadata, or publishing derived observations for either date layer source. Keep those activities unauthorized/unconfirmed until an authoritative product-specific license/terms document is located. Do not borrow a license from another product.
